translationRepairs: Once he stayed overnight drinking at Prince Xin of Beihai's residence with Pingyang Gu of Youbei, Pei Bomo of Hedong, his paternal cousin Fei, and Lu Daohui of Henan; they composed several dozen poems together, all left with the host's servant.

Once he stayed overnight drinking at Prince Xin of Beihai's residence with Yang Gu of Youbeiping, Pei Bomo of Hedong, his paternal cousin Fei, and Lu Daohui of Henan; they composed several dozen poems together, all left with the host's servant.
右北平陽固 names Yang Gu of Youbeiping; the before text wrongly splits the commandery and surname as Pingyang Gu of Youbei. The proposed replacement restores place and personal name.

He once lodged and drank overnight at the house of the Prince of Beihai, Xin, with Youbei Pingyang Gu, Hedong Pei Bomo, his cousin from the father's line Fei, and Henan Lu Daohui; together they composed poems, several dozen in all, and all were left with the host's servant.

He once lodged and drank overnight at the house of the Prince of Beihai, Xin, with Youbeiping Yang Gu, Hedong Pei Bomo, his cousin from the father's line Fei, and Henan Lu Daohui; together they composed poems, several dozen in all, and all were left with the host's servant.
The same 右北平陽固 must be read as Youbeiping Yang Gu in the literal line; Youbei Pingyang Gu is a mis-segmentation of place and name.
Leaving mourning, he served as a Wei mourning officer for Emperor Xuanwu, was made gentleman attendant at court, and rose to assistant in the bureau of weights and measures.
Leaving mourning, he served as a Wei mourning officer for Emperor Xuanwu, was made gentleman attendant at court, and rose to assistant editorial director.
遷著作佐郎 promotes him to assistant editorial director (historiographical office). Bureau of weights and measures invents a different post not present in the Chinese.
He doffed mourning and became a Wei mourning officer for Emperor Xuanwu, was appointed gentleman attendant at court, and was promoted assistant in the Bureau of Weights and Measures.
He doffed mourning and became a Wei mourning officer for Emperor Xuanwu, was appointed gentleman attendant at court, and was promoted Assistant Editorial Director.
Literal likewise misrenders 著作佐郎 as Bureau of Weights and Measures; Assistant Editorial Director correctly names the editorial assistantship.
On completing mourning for his mother his grief exceeded the rites.
On observing mourning for his mother his grief exceeded the rites.
丁母憂 means entering/observing mourning for one’s mother; completing mourning reverses the sense. Observing mourning corrects that error.
Emperor Wuzong of Wei took up the former thread; in Yongping he launched great construction.
Emperor Shizong of Wei took up the former thread; in Yongping he launched great construction.
世宗 is the temple name Shizong (Emperor Xuanwu of Northern Wei, whose Yongping era matches the unit); Wuzong would be 武宗 and is unsupported.
Emperor Wuzong of Wei continued the former thread; in Yongping he greatly raised timber and earthworks.
Emperor Shizong of Wei continued the former thread; in Yongping he greatly raised timber and earthworks.
The literal field has the same 世宗 → Wuzong error; Shizong restores the correct temple name alongside Yongping.
